description: This header file defines functions and includes necessary dependencies for reading and processing TensorFlow SavedModel protobuf files. It declares functions to load the SavedModel, find MetaGraphDef instances based on tags, and read debug information. It also manages external dependencies such as protobufs and TensorFlow core components.

methods.name: ReadSavedModel
methods.description: Reads the SavedModel protobuf from the specified directory into a SavedModel object.

methods.name: FindMetaGraphDef
methods.description: Finds and returns a pointer to a MetaGraphDef within the SavedModel that matches the provided tags.

methods.name: ReadMetaGraphDefFromSavedModel
methods.description: Loads a SavedModel protobuf from disk, finds the matching MetaGraphDef, and writes it to the provided output parameter.

methods.name: ReadSavedModelDebugInfoIfPresent
methods.description: Optionsally reads debug information from the SavedModel export directory if present.
